mapper.select: SELECT member_id AS memberId, login_id AS loginId, member_name AS memberName, password_hash AS passwordHash, email, phone, member_role AS memberRole, member_status AS memberStatus FROM members WHERE login_id = #{loginId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO members( login_id, password_hash, member_name, email, phone ) VALUES ( #{loginId}, #{password}, #{memberName}, LOWER(TRIM(#{email})), #{phone} )

INSERT INTO member_addresses ( member_id, address_label, recipient_name, recipient_phone, postal_code, address_line1, address_line2, is_default ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, '기본 배송지', #{memberName}, #{phone}, #{postalCode}, #{addressLine1}, #{addressLine2}, 'Y' )
